tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per KG-3 tender document
Tenderer is liable for rejection if incase tenderer fails to upload any documents or certificate mentioned in tender document

Sample must be submitted before closing date of the tender in properly sealed manner. Bidder need to uploaded OC of sample submitted. Tender Evaluation technical committee will open on date of technical evaluation. Only selected items will be qualified for financial evaluation.
Acknowledgement to provide Difference Amount incase tenderer quoted rate below estimated rates during the time of agreement

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annexure Authorization Letter for signing of Bid documents
Annexure Format for the bidder on Non Blacklist requirement by the Bidder on Rs 100 e stamp paper notarized.
Annexure Land border declaration is to be provided by OEM or bidders in Letter Head
Annual turnover certificate should be certified by CA having UDIN number
Bidder Should submit work order and work done certificate
ISO Certificate of the tenderer accredited by NABCB
Line of Credit 30 percent of the estimated value
Minimum Last 3 Years IT Returns and Proffit and Loss statement and Balance Sheet certified by CA
Section VIII As per format of Form of Tender
Valid Company GST and PAN Certificate should be submitted
